spans.s: RS0057 दिवसद्वन्दम divasadvandama Indicating the period in any process

SV0090 दिवास्वप divāsvapa Sleeping during day time. It should be avoided by healthy individuals otherwise it may cause increase of kapha, Meda. Except during grisma (summer) at all other time day sleep is prohibited. Day sleep is not nap.
BP0095 दिवास्वप्न divāsvapna Sleeping during day time

AT0096 दिव्य सर्प divya sarpa Mysterious mythological celestial snakes which are radiant just like fire and it is said that they always roar, cause rain, shine by themselves and always support and sustain the world, when become angry convert the world to ashes by their sight and exhalation.
